title: Bug fix with hidden tests (Node, no dependencies)
prompt: Issue #12: `slugify` produces wrong URLs. Titles with accents keep them ("Árbol de Navidad" gives "árbol-de-navidad", it should be "arbol-de-navidad"), consecutive separators produce several dashes ("a -- b" gives "a----b") and the result can start or end with a dash. Fix it in src/slugify.js, add tests for each case, run the checks and finish.
